$comment: Every project under WittyMediaServer, for the projects page. Keep it in step with docs/REPOSITORIES.md in the server's repository. Modules in the catalog are added by themselves; list them here only to say more. kind: app, module, library or planned.

groups.title: Modules
groups.intro: Added to a server from its store, each a project of its own.

groups.title: Behind the scenes
groups.intro: Parts the apps and modules are built from.

groups.title: Not started yet
groups.intro: Named in the roadmap, with nothing built.

projects.name: WittyMediaServer
projects.summary: The server: your films, shows, discs, music, books and games, streamed to every screen in your home.

projects.name: WittyMediaClient
projects.summary: Apps for desktops, Android, Android TV, iPhone, iPad, Apple TV and Plasma Bigscreen that connect to your server. Early.

projects.name: WittyMediaPlayer
projects.summary: A desktop player for discs and files, with real DVD and Blu-ray menus. Windows only for now.

projects.name: WittyReader
projects.summary: A desktop reader for books, PDFs and comics, with notes and a pen. No server needed.

projects.name: WittyModule
projects.summary: The manifest format, tools and kit that modules are built with.

projects.name: WittyModuleCatalog
projects.summary: The signed list of modules and versions that a server's store reads. It holds no module code.

projects.name: WittyMediaRemoteMedia
projects.summary: Connecting libraries on a NAS through a native or Docker app.
